title: TWM41/TWM35 — Control test mode entry
description: Soak + Extra Rinse + Power together; tests 2–5 for motor, spin/pump, inlet valves, auto-sensing.

source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TWM41WH8A / NS-TWM35W1 top-load washer (capacitive level)

steps.title: Empty tub before test mode
steps.body: Empty the drum (spin cycle or front service panel). Water level sensor must be installed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Empty machine so no water left; water level sensor should be installed.

steps.title: Enter test mode
steps.body: Press Soak, Extra Rinse, and Power together. All lights and display ON then 6 beeps — any light off, display not 88, or no beep → replace PCB. Within 9 s: Soil Level = wash test (3 min); Temp = spin/pump test; Fabric Softener = inlet valve + version; Delay = auto-sensing.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Soak, Extra Rinse and Power together to enter test mode.
